mapper.select: select order_id, order_no, member_id, site_id, community_id, status, service_name, appoint_time, pay_amount, plate_no, cancel_reason, del_flag, create_time, update_time from wash_order where order by create_time desc limit #{offset}, #{pageSize}

select order_id, order_no, service_id, vehicle_id, cabinet_id, member_id, site_id, community_id, status, service_name, appoint_time, pay_amount, pay_expire_at, plate_no, cancel_reason, del_flag, create_time, update_time from wash_order where order_no = #{orderNo} and del_flag = '0' limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into wash_order (order_no, service_id, vehicle_id, cabinet_id, member_id, site_id, community_id, status, service_name, appoint_time, pay_amount, pay_expire_at, plate_no, remark, del_flag, create_time) values (#{orderNo}, #{serviceId}, #{vehicleId}, #{cabinetId}, #{memberId}, #{siteId}, #{communityId}, #{status}, #{serviceName}, #{appointTime}, #{payAmount}, #{payExpireAt}, #{plateNo}, #{remark}, '0', sysdate())
